saw_lines: Cyclists buy bike lights and tools when the old one dies, and they check shipping before they pay.
So a buyer who sees no shipping answer or discount in the ad clicks away to a shop that shows both.
Your site shows 2819 reviews, yet that number appears in 0 of 30 ads. Put it on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 2819 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a cold buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Put the 2819 count on every creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site promotes up to 50% off, yet 0 of 29 ads mention percent off. A buyer with no price reason stays on the page. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on every creative.

Your site answers how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A new buyer who cannot tell when it arrives scrolls past. Answer shipping in line one for new buyers and name the €85 threshold.

Your 29 copy ads open with 15 different stories, and the biggest, the Lytes launch, opens 5 of them. Pick the two strongest stories and make the next batch from only those, with one new offer line in each.

ads_1: Lytes creative led by the 50% off offer and the 2819 review count
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
